name: finviz_screener_txn_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: finviz_screener_txn_20261107 — the screener runner reported success for work the database
never received. Read-only DB check 2026-11-07: of 45 active screeners, last_run was 2026-08-27 for 38,
2026-08-26 for 3, and only 4 held any screener_symbol_membership row newer than 2026-08-27, while the
"db_write_failures": 0} status ok (and the 11-06 run died executor_lost at 1233 s). Cause in
scripts/finviz_screener_runner.py: each screener's rows are written inside a SAVEPOINT that is only
RELEASEd, and the loop then calls _refresh_conn() -> db_adapter.ensure_conn(), which probes with
SELECT 1 and then conn.rollback() (scripts/db_adapter.py:283-284): the next screener's fetch discarded
every earlier screener's work, and the single commit after the loop persisted only the last screener —
or nothing when its tail returned no rows. The gate pins the contract: each screener's writes are
committed before the next fetch refreshes the handle, the summary counts only what the database took
(total_new_tickers equals the committed classification inserts), a failed commit is db_ok False plus a
db_write_failure and its tickers are not counted, and an empty screener does not hide the earlier ones.
Hermetic: fake connection modelling commit/rollback/SAVEPOINT, fake fetcher; no DB, no network, no
